title: Brazilian Portuguese Survival Vocabulary — 1,500 (Frequency-Informed)
description: Brazilian Portuguese to English. Curated survival core followed by frequency-ranked Brazilian vocabulary.
attribution: Frequency ordering adapted from hermitdave/FrequencyWords 2018 pt_br (OpenSubtitles), CC BY-SA 4.0. English glosses adapted from Lector's Portuguese-English dictionary (Wiktionary via kaikki.org), CC BY-SA 4.0. Entries were grouped, shortened, filtered, corrected, and modified for learners.
